translationRepairs: Tongzhi year one brought promotion to supervising secretary of rites. He impeached Huang Bin, Yangtze naval commander, for stealing likin and aiding rebels; Grand Secretary Sheng Bao for greed and obstruction; and General Cheng Ming for hoarding troops at Tongzhou without fighting spirit. He was hailed as a fearless censor.

Tongzhi year one brought promotion to supervising secretary of rites. He impeached Huang Bin, Yangtze naval commander, for stealing likin and aiding rebels; military-affairs vice minister Sheng Bao for greed and obstruction; and General Cheng Ming for hoarding troops at Tongzhou without fighting spirit. He was hailed as a fearless censor.
Source title is 督辦軍務侍郎, a vice minister, not Grand Secretary.

When France invaded Vietnam, he and Hunan governor Peng Zuxian were ordered to strengthen Yangtze defenses. Bian built three gun platforms on each bank at Tianjiazhen and sent illustrated plans to the court.

When France invaded Vietnam, he and governor Peng Zuxian were ordered to strengthen Yangtze defenses. Bian built three gun platforms on each bank at Tianjiazhen and sent illustrated plans to the court.
Source says only 巡撫; Bian himself held the Hunan post, so 'Hunan' is unsupported.
People wept with gratitude and said as one, "Vice-Governor Ding is the man who saved our lives!"
People wept with gratitude and said as one, "Governor Ding is the man who saved our lives!"
丁中丞 uses the conventional honorific for a provincial governor, which Ding was.
A passionate bibliophile, he compiled the five-volume catalogue of his Chijing Studio collection, which contemporaries ranked beside Fan Qin's Tianyi Pavilion and Huang Pilie's Hundred Song Studio.

A passionate bibliophile, he compiled the five-volume catalogue of his Chijing Studio collection, which contemporaries ranked beside the Fan family's Tianyi Pavilion and the Huang family's Hundred Song Studio.
Source has only 范氏 and 黃氏; personal names are not in the text.

After the French treaty, Bian wrote: "Foreign trade lets every power take advantage; we need the resolve of King Goujian—sleeping on brushwood, tasting gall—and plans as if disaster were always one season away."

After the French treaty, Bian wrote: "Foreign trade lets every power take advantage; we need the resolve of sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall, and plans as if disaster were always one season away."
Source uses the idiom 臥薪嘗膽 only; it does not name Goujian.
When his term ended, Minister of Rites Shi Zanqing recommended him to act as provincial treasurer.
When his term ended, Chief Minister of the Court of Sacrificial Worship Shi Zanqing recommended him to act as provincial treasurer.
Source title is 太常寺卿, not Minister of Rites.
Guiyang was recovered, Pan Mingjie fled, and Guizhou's counteroffensive began.
Guiding was recovered, Pan Mingjie fled, and Guizhou's counteroffensive began.
Source has 貴定 (Guiding), not Guiyang.
Lop Nur was the Star Sea of old histories, Han-era territory of Shanshan, Weili, and Ruoqiang—1,600 li east-west, up to a thousand li north-south; when the Yang Pass route closed it became a vacuum.
Lop Nur was the Star Sea of old histories, Han-era territory of Qiemo, Weili, and Ruoqiang—1,600 li east-west, up to a thousand li north-south; when the Yang Pass route closed it became a vacuum.
Source lists 且末, not 鄯善 (Shanshan).
Russia regretted the move and daily pressed the Grand Council to withdraw Chinese troops.
Russia regretted the move and daily pressed the Zongli Yamen to withdraw Chinese troops.
總署 is the Zongli Yamen (foreign office), not the Grand Council (軍機處).
The Grand Council negotiated with Britain, ceding Kashgar districts to India while Tadunbash Pamir and all Lasikumu went to China.
The Zongli Yamen negotiated with Britain, ceding Kashgar districts to India while Tadunbash Pamir and all Lasikumu went to China.
總署 is the Zongli Yamen, not the Grand Council.
He banned forced remarriage of widows and punished the governor's runners and local bully Yang Ying.
He banned forced remarriage of widows and punished the governor's runners and local man Yang Yingbian.
Source 鄉人楊營弁 gives the name 楊營弁 and says only 鄉人 (local man); 'bully' and the truncated 'Yang Ying' are unsupported.
Yun Zuoyi, courtesy name Shumou, came from Huyang in Jiangsu.
Yun Zuyi, courtesy name Shumou, came from Huyang in Jiangsu.
Li Peijing was capable and steadfast; the Song brothers served faithfully; Bian Baoquan kept pure integrity; Yun Zuoyi handled crises—each deserves mention.
Li Peijing was capable and steadfast; the Song brothers served faithfully; Bian Baoquan kept pure integrity; Yun Zuyi handled crises—each deserves mention.
Zhan post inspector's land, 240 li from Turfan, ancient Shanshan, becomes Shanshan County.
Pizhan post inspector's land, 240 li from Turfan, ancient Shanshan, becomes Shanshan County.
Source place name is 闢展 (Pizhan).
